chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), who said:

The scribes/reciters of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) know that the people of Saffin have been cursed by God upon the tongue of His Prophet, and he who fabricated [the truth] has certainly failed.

key_terms.أَهْلَ صِفِّينَ: The people of Saffin, referring to the combatants in the Battle of Siffin
key_terms.عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ: Upon the tongue of His Prophet

ai.seo_question: Who were the people of Saffin cursed by God according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (a.s.) highlights that the knowledgeable companions (*al-Mustahfizun*) were fully aware that the people of Siffin were divinely cursed through the Prophet Muhammad’s tongue, a fact well-established in Shia tradition. The narration concludes by affirming that those who fabricated narratives regarding this event have indeed failed, underscoring the authenticity of the curse against the opposing forces at Siffin.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-276 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.),
“The loyal companions of Muhammad remember that God cursed the people of Saffayn by means of the tongue of His Prophet. It does not matter if anyone lies about this.”
